subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The `options` object passed to `contentstack.Stack(options)` has no `live_preview` configuration key. Without `live_preview: { management_token, host, enable }` in the SDK options, the Contentstack SDK never initializes its live preview subsystem. Consequently, `Stack.livePreview.onEntryChange` (subscribed in ContentstackContext.tsx) will never fire — the subscription is dead code. Every acceptance criterion requiring real-time draft content updates is unmet.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview: { management_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN || '', host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST || '', enable: !!(process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN) }` to the `options` object. Also destructure CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST from process.env and log a warning if the token is missing when live preview is expected.

issues.description: No `includeDraft` field exists on IContentstackGetEntry, IContentstackGetSingleEntry, IContentstackGetSingletonEntry, ICreateQueryConfig, or ICreateEntryConfig. The public-facing service functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getSingletonEntry, findSingletonEntry) do not accept or propagate `includeDraft` to the factory/query layer. Without this, draft content can never be fetched — the preview site will only show published content, failing the core acceptance criterion that unpublished draft entries render on the preview site.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `includeDraft?: boolean` to ICommonContentstackConfig (so it propagates to all derived interfaces). In ContentstackFactory.setCommonConfig, when includeDraft is true, call `query.addParam('include_draft', 'true')`. Pass includeDraft through from each public function's config to the factory.

issues.description: The `onEntryChange` callback casts incoming data as `Partial<IContentstackContent>` and merges it via shallow spread. Contentstack's live preview callback delivers a single entry object (with fields like `entry`, `content_type_uid`), not a partial of IContentstackContent. The data shape does not match — `updateContent` would spread raw SDK payload fields (e.g., `entry`, `content_type_uid`) into the content state, corrupting it rather than merging the updated entry into the correct content-type key (e.g., `page`, `header`, `footer`).
issues.suggestedFix: Map the incoming live preview event to the correct IContentstackContent key based on `content_type_uid`. For example: if the event's content_type_uid matches a page type, set `content.page` to the updated entry array; if it matches header, set `content.header`, etc. Do not blindly spread the SDK payload.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests were added for the live preview / includeDraft functionality. Grep across test/ for 'live_preview', 'livePreview', 'includeDraft', 'include_draft', 'ContentstackContext', 'ContentstackProvider' returned zero results. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path. There are zero tests verifying that updateContent merges into state, that the initial state matches defaultContent, that onEntryChange is registered when livePreview.enabled is true, or that includeDraft: true causes addParam('include_draft', 'true').
issues.suggestedFix: Add test/unit/context/ContentstackContext.spec.tsx testing: (1) initial content state equals defaultContent, (2) updateContent merges partial updates and triggers re-render, (3) onEntryChange subscription is registered when enabled, (4) onEntryChange is NOT registered when disabled. Add test/unit/services/contentstack.spec.ts testing: (1) options include live_preview config when token is present, (2) includeDraft: true adds include_draft param to query.

issues.description: Added `previewId`, `isPreview`, `previewTimestamp` fields to IContentCard — these are not part of the prescribed minimal fix and add unnecessary surface area. The prescribed fix is: replace useMemo with useState + add onEntryChange listener in the provider. No interface changes to content card types are needed. This is over-engineering that violates the concision requirement.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove `previewId`, `isPreview`, and `previewTimestamp` from IContentCard. The live preview mechanism works through the context provider's state update — no per-card preview metadata is needed.

issues.description: Added `previewMode` prop and `livePreview` context usage to append `live_preview` query params to link hrefs. This is not part of the prescribed minimal fix and adds unnecessary complexity. The prescribed fix is solely: provider uses useState + onEntryChange listener. Link-level preview param injection is a separate concern not required by any acceptance criterion. A more concise change (zero changes to ContentstackLink) meets the same ACs.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the `previewMode` prop, the `useContentstackContext` call for `livePreview`, and the preview param logic. Revert ContentstackLink to its original implementation. Live preview content updates flow through the context provider — link components do not need modification.

issues.description: The `Stack as unknown as { livePreview?: ... }` cast is untyped and fragile. If the Contentstack SDK's live preview API shape changes, this will silently fail (the `typeof` check returns false and no listener is registered) with no error or warning logged. This violates the TypeScript strict compliance criterion — the cast to `unknown` then to a hand-rolled interface bypasses the SDK's actual types.
issues.suggestedFix: Import the proper type from the Contentstack SDK (e.g., `import contentstack from 'contentstack'` and use `contentstack.Stack['livePreview']`), or create a properly typed wrapper. At minimum, add a `console.warn` or `logger.warn` in the else branch when `onEntryChange` is not a function so silent failure is observable.

issues.description: The `useEffect` that syncs `defaultContent` into state on every `defaultContent` change will overwrite live preview updates. If a parent re-renders and passes the same `defaultContent` reference (or a shallow-changed one), the effect fires and spreads `defaultContent` over `previousContent`, potentially clobbering draft entries that were merged via `updateContent`. This creates a race condition between live preview updates and parent-driven content resets.
issues.suggestedFix: Only initialize state from `defaultContent` on mount (empty dependency array), or use a ref to track whether the initial sync has occurred and skip subsequent syncs. Alternatively, merge `defaultContent` only for keys not already present in state.
